item.title: Contraline Male Contraceptive
item.description:
• Summary: Contraline has raised a Series B financing to advance its male contraceptive technology, which involves a hydrogel implant that blocks sperm. The company aims to provide a long-acting, reversible alternative to vasectomy.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Pharmaceutical Technology

item.title: GLP-1 Employer Coverage
item.description:
• Summary: The article from Endpoints News discusses the barriers and potential solutions for increasing employer coverage of GLP-1 receptor agonists, which are used for diabetes and weight loss. It explores cost concerns, employee health outcomes, and benefit design strategies.
  • MoAs: GLP-1 receptor agonists mimic incretin hormones, stimulating insulin secretion, suppressing glucagon release, slowing gastric emptying, and promoting satiety.
  • Sources: Endpoints News
